thread_title: S. flava var. rubricorpora Liberty Co, FL clone B
breadcrumb: S. flava var. rubricorpora Liberty Co, FL clone B

posts.body_html:
Here's another rubricorpora clone from the liberty Co, FL population. It is very similar to the many other clones I have in the collection. The traps this year from clone B formed a bit later than normal, but I think it's because this plant was recently divided, which may have thrown it off a bit. Plant has a solid red body and cool shape to the mouth
